exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Give way to Boeing 777 crossing left to right on Bravo
exchanges.meaning: Yield right-of-way to intersecting taxi traffic — hold short of the intersection until the crossing Boeing 777 passes clear.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.meaning: Mandatory instruction to stop before the runway holding point markings (two solid and two dashed yellow lines); must be read back verbatim.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.meaning: The pilot asks ATC for step-by-step turn-by-turn guidance, used in low visibility or at unfamiliar airports.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request taxi.
exchanges.meaning: The pilot requests taxi clearance from the stand.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via taxiway Alpha and Hotel. Give way to Boeing 777 crossing left to right on Bravo.
exchanges.meaning: Taxi clearance to the Runway 07R holding point via taxiways Alpha and Hotel, with an instruction to yield to a crossing Boeing 777 on Bravo.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, give way to the Boeing 777 on Bravo, Cathay 251.
exchanges.meaning: Readback of the taxi route and the give-way instruction.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay 251, hold short of Runway 07 Left on Hotel.
exchanges.meaning: ATC instructs the aircraft to stop before the Runway 07L holding point while on taxiway Hotel.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Hold short Runway 07 Left on Hotel, Cathay 251.
exchanges.meaning: Verbatim readback of the mandatory hold-short instruction.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, low visibility, request progressive taxi to Runway 07 Right.
exchanges.meaning: In dense fog (RVR 400m), the crew requests step-by-step progressive taxi guidance to Runway 07R.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay 251, progressive taxi approved. Follow taxiway Alpha, turn left onto taxiway Juliet, hold short of taxiway Hotel.
exchanges.meaning: ATC approves progressive taxi and issues the first turn-by-turn instructions.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Follow Alpha, left on Juliet, hold short of Hotel, Cathay 251.
exchanges.meaning: Readback of the first progressive taxi instructions.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay 251, proceed across Hotel, continue to holding point Runway 07 Right, hold short Runway 07 Left.
exchanges.meaning: Continued progressive guidance: cross Hotel, continue to the Runway 07R holding point, and hold short of Runway 07L.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Across Hotel, to holding point Runway 07 Right, hold short Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
exchanges.meaning: Readback of the continued progressive taxi instructions including the final hold-short.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
exchanges.meaning: Taxi clearance with a mandatory hold-short instruction before Runway 07L.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, crossing Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
exchanges.meaning: A dangerous faulty readback — the pilot said 'crossing Runway 07 Left' instead of 'hold short', which the controller must catch immediately.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! HOLD SHORT of Runway 07 Left.
exchanges.meaning: The controller urgently rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the mandatory hold-short instruction.

vocabulary.definition: Turn-by-turn taxi guidance issued by ATC, used in dense fog (Low Visibility Procedures), at night, or at complex unfamiliar airports.

A mandatory instruction to stop before the runway holding point markings (two solid and two dashed yellow lines); crossing a runway without explicit clearance is the #1 cause of catastrophic runway incursion collisions.
An instruction to yield right-of-way to intersecting taxi traffic — hold short of the intersection until the crossing aircraft passes clear.
White lettering on a red background (e.g. 07L - 25R NO ENTRY) marking a runway holding point or prohibited area; it must never be crossed without explicit ATC clearance.
Yellow letters on a black background ('Black square, you're there!') identifying the taxiway the aircraft is currently on.
Black letters on yellow with an arrow ('Yellow array, points the way!') identifying intersecting taxiways and turns.
Calculated Take-Off Time — the departure slot time, with a permitted window of −5 minutes to +10 minutes around it.

quiz.question: While taxiing on an aerodrome, you observe a sign with WHITE lettering on a RED background displaying "07L-25R". What does this sign signify and what action is required?
options: It indicates the taxiway you are currently on; you may proceed at normal taxi speed.
It is a direction sign indicating that Runway 07L-25R is located to your left.
It is a mandatory instruction sign marking the holding position for Runway 07L-25R; you must NOT cross this line without specific ATC clearance.
It indicates an unserviceable area of the aerodrome where taxiing is prohibited.
quiz.explanation: Under ICAO Annex 14, white characters on a red background denote a Mandatory Instruction Sign (e.g. runway holding position or no-entry sign). Pilots are legally forbidden from crossing a mandatory sign without explicit ATC clearance.

quiz.question: If the surface ambient temperature is 23°C and the dewpoint is 18°C, at approximately what height above ground level (AGL) will the base of convective cumulus clouds form?
quiz.explanation: Using the convergence formula: (Temperature − Dewpoint) × 400 = cloud base AGL. Here 23°C − 18°C = 5°C spread, and 5 × 400 = 2,000 feet AGL.

sections.heading: Core Learning Content — Taxi Clearance & Signage Guide
sections.body: Taxiway operations require strict adherence to standard syntax and visual signage (ICAO Annex 14 / Doc 9432). Mandatory Sign: 07L - 25R NO ENTRY — white on red: runway holding point or prohibited area; NEVER cross without explicit clearance. Location Sign: A H — yellow on black ('Black square, you're there!'): identifies the taxiway your aircraft is currently on. Direction Sign: ← A H → — black on yellow ('Yellow array, points the way!'): identifies intersecting taxiways and turns. Give Way Rule: 'Give way to B777 crossing left to right on Bravo' — hold short of the intersection until the crossing aircraft passes clear. Progressive Taxi: 'Request progressive taxi instructions' — step-by-step turn guidance issued by ATC during low visibility or unfamiliar airport layouts.

sections.heading: Spaced Repetition (Forgetting Curve) Review
sections.body: Day 4 & Day 5 recall: 1. CTOT = Calculated Take-Off Time (departure slot time). 2. Slot time tolerance window: −5 minutes to +10 minutes around the CTOT. 3. 'Facing west' in pushback refers to the direction the NOSE of the aircraft points when finished.

sections.heading: Fun Aviation Fact — The Airport Signage Rhyme
sections.body: Pilots memorize this classic rhyme to prevent disorientation on taxiway networks: 'Black square, you're there!' (yellow letters on black = Location sign); 'Yellow array, points the way!' (black letters on yellow with an arrow = Direction sign); 'Red and white, runway in sight!' (white letters on red = Mandatory stop sign).
